sections.title: Lesson : 8 Animal Life > Highlights of the Lesson
sections.content_text: - Animals around us - Land Animals - Water Animals - Birds - Insects - Animal Homes Animals are living beings like us which are found in nature. Animals are found all over the world and they need food, shelter, air, and water like other living beings, to grow and survive. Their size, eating habits, body colour, and body covering vary according to the place they are found in. All animals need care and protection. Animals live both on land and in water.

sections.title: Lesson : 8 Animal Life > Highlights of the Lesson > Water animals.
sections.content_text: Animals that live in water are called “Water Animals or Aquatic Animals”.

sections.title: Lesson : 8 Animal Life > Highlights of the Lesson > Water animals. > Land animals.
sections.content_text: Animals that live on land are called “Land Animals”. Lion Elephant Tiger

sections.title: Lesson : 8 Animal Life > Highlights of the Lesson > Water animals. > Land animals. > Birds
sections.content_text: Birds are the animals with feathers, wings and two-legs and a beak without teeth. Duck Pigeon Parrot

sections.title: Lesson : 8 Animal Life > Highlights of the Lesson > Water animals. > Land animals. > Birds > Insects
sections.content_text: Very small animals are called “Insects”. They have six legs. Some insects have wings to fly. Butterfly Housefly Grasshopper Domestic Animals: Animals that are kept at home or around our homes are called “Domestic Animals”. They are useful to us. Pet Animals: Some animals like dog, parrot and rabbit are kept as pets. We love them and take care of them. Wild Animals : Some animals can be seen only in the forests. They are called “Wild Animals”.

sections.title: Lesson : 8 Animal Life > Highlights of the Lesson > Water animals. > Land animals. > Birds > Animal Homes :
sections.content_text: Animals need home to live and food to grow. Different animals eat different kinds of food and live in different homes.

sections.title: Lesson : 8 Animal Life > Highlights of the Lesson > Water animals. > Land animals. > Birds > Lions :
sections.content_text: - Lions live in caves in forests. - These caves are called “Dens”. - They eat flesh of other animals.

sections.title: Lesson : 8 Animal Life > Highlights of the Lesson > Water animals. > Land animals. > Birds > Rabbits :
sections.content_text: - They are burrowing animals and live in burrows - They eat vegetables. Birds : - Birds build their own nest. - They eat seeds, berries, fruit, insects, etc. Ants : - They make a hill-like structure using sand called “Anthill”. - Ants live in a group like bees.

sections.title: Lesson : 8 Animal Life > Highlights of the Lesson > Water animals. > Land animals. > Birds > Domestic and pet animals are kept in human-made homes. A dog lives in a kennel
sections.content_text: A cow lives in a shed A horse lives in a stable

sections.title: Lesson : 8 Animal Life > Highlights of the Lesson > Let’s Recall
sections.content_text: - Animals live both on land and in water. - Animals are of different sizes. - Animals that can fly are called birds. - Very small animals are called insects. - Animals that can be kept at home are domestic animals. - Animals that live in jungle are called wild animals. - Different animals live in different homes and eat different foods.

sections.title: Lesson : 8 Animal Life > Glossary
sections.content_text: - Birds : Animals that can fly are called birds. - Insects : Very small animals are called insects. - Domestic animals: animals that can be kept at home. - Wild animals : Animals that live in jungle.. - Den : Place where lions live. Assessment
